materialization_rule: The exact primary owner map is materialized from SOURCE_UNITS in R29_COMPRESSION_V0.1_PART_A/B/C. Each listed parse unit receives the compression item's ITEM_ID. A one-unit item receives DIRECT_TO_COMPRESSION_ITEM; an item with more than one SOURCE_UNIT receives LOSS_BOUNDED_GROUP_TO_COMPRESSION_ITEM for every member. No additional or implicit mapping exists.
integrity_note: The owner-map hash is over the 266 ordered materialized rows under owner_map_schema. Exact unit membership is independently persisted in each compression item's SOURCE_UNITS array, so the ledger does not duplicate the 266 rows textually.
